In times of uncertainty and trial, the kind that the world is facing, the only thing that holds the heart is Dua (supplication).

Dua is said to be the weapon of the believer. Seeking Allahs special mercy through duas, to protect and uplift ourselves and be guided especially in difficult times is what we all need.

The app has especially been design to allow reading daily Duas in a fresh and Beautiful manner! 

All supplications are authentic, from the Quran and Sunnah. 

Every time you open the app, a fresh new organization of the Quranic and Masnoon Duas is presented. 

A bookmark feature allows you to save the position where you left reading your daily stream, allowing you to come back to it and continue reading even at a later time or day. 

Mark your favorite duas with the heart icon for easy reference to your beloved duas in the favorites tab. 

Daily receive a special supplication, along with its recitation and explanation by Dr. Farhat Hashmi.

The duas are available in the Arabic language, along with Urdu and English translation. 

The fonts are also customization to the script of your liking. Three options are available for you to choose.
